segments.content:
Chapter 196 They All Bought Them For Me

"Are all girls like this when they buy clothes?"

"I guess so."

It was past three in the afternoon.

Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun were sitting on a long bench in a women's clothing store, watching the five girls over there walk among the dazzling array of clothes, picking and choosing.

The two of them had already been sitting here for nearly an hour.

Next to the bench were seven or eight bags containing the spoils of their own shopping.

After setting out from Fuyi High School at noon and taking a bus to Yintai Department Store, they had first gone to buy clothes for their elders.

Zhao Rongjun picked out two down jackets, while Li Luo chose one piece each for his paternal and maternal grandparents, as well as his parents. All told, it took less than half an hour.

And after the two of them were done, the girls' shopping time began.

"So can I leave first?" Zhao Rongjun asked in a low voice. "Anyway, they mainly came with you. It won't make a difference if I leave, right?"

"You have the heart to leave me here to suffer all alone?" Li Luo hooked an arm around his neck. "This is also a chance for you to grow. You shouldn't waste it."

"Grow what?" Zhao Rongjun looked completely speechless. "Isn't it just waiting here? It was pretty much the same when I used to go shopping with my mom."

"You just don't get it, do you?" Li Luo shook his head. "When girls go out shopping, what they want is a sense of satisfaction and validation. Just watch."

As soon as he finished speaking, Ying Chanxi finally picked out a style of down jacket. She walked over to Li Luo with two different colors in her hands and held them up against herself.

"Li Luo, does this look good?"

"It does." Li Luo nodded. "But, I think the white one suits your temperament better. This orange one is more suitable for Senior."

"Really?" Xu Youyu, who was standing nearby, took the orange jacket from Ying Chanxi's hands and held it up against herself.

Ying Chanxi also looked down at the white one in her hands. "Then should I go try it on?"

"Yes, you can try it." Li Luo got up and walked over, conveniently grabbing two other down jackets from the rack. "These are all white. I think you always look especially good in white clothes. You can try them all on."

"Oh, okay." Ying Chanxi was a little happy and nodded immediately. "Then I'll try them on. You can see which one is better."

At that moment, Xu Youyu asked Li Luo, "Does this one really suit me?"

"It suits you, but not perfectly." After watching Ying Chanxi go to try on the clothes, Li Luo turned to Xu Youyu and said, "Senior, you have more of an aura when you wear warm-toned clothes, but this one makes you look a bit juvenile. You can try these two."

As he spoke, Li Luo took another three down jackets from the rack and handed them to Xu Youyu. "Want to try them?"

"Oh, okay." Xu Youyu raised her eyebrows, giving Li Luo a few surprised glances before nodding with a faint smile and going to the side to try them on.

Yan Zhusheng, who hadn't been doing much picking, suddenly appeared and asked by Li Luo's ear, "What about me?"

"You." Li Luo glanced at her and picked out a jacket for her as well. "This one."

"Why do I only get one?" Yan Zhusheng looked at the beige down jacket in her hands and asked in confusion.

"You don't usually buy clothes, so you're easier to fool."

Among the five girls, Yan Zhusheng was the only one who had been consistently unenthusiastic about shopping. She was clearly a rare species uninterested in it.

In Li Luo's memory, back when he worked under Yan Zhusheng in his past life, she had always worn the same few outfits on rotation and rarely had new clothes.

Most of her thoughts were on enjoying music, and she didn't care much about her appearance.

Of course, with a face so exquisite it looked as if it were carved, whatever she wore was just icing on the cake.

With clothes like down jackets that could perfectly conceal her figure, what she wore didn't make much of a difference.

"So, are we going to the store next door later?" Yan Zhusheng simply tried it on for size. After confirming it was fine, she asked the salesperson to bag it up, and then turned to Li Luo.

"What store next door?" Li Luo asked, puzzled.

"The men's clothing store." Yan Zhusheng glanced at the scarf around Li Luo's neck, then averted her gaze. "I want to buy you an outfit, as a New Year's gift."

"Huh? What gift?" Ying Chanxi had just changed into a down jacket and ran over for Li Luo to see when she heard what Yan Zhusheng said. "What is Zhusheng doing?"

"She wants to buy me some clothes," Li Luo said honestly.

"Oh, right." Ying Chanxi then came to her senses and looked at Li Luo. "You only bought clothes for your elders just now, not for yourself, right?"

"My mom will buy some for me for the New Year," Li Luo said helplessly.

"That won't do," Ying Chanxi said at once. "It's a rare trip out. After we're done buying ours, let's get you a set too."

"Let's focus on yours first." Li Luo waved his hand, first helping Ying Chanxi check the down jacket she was wearing and offering a few suggestions.

After a busy twenty minutes, Li Luo finally got them all to choose their clothes and had the salesperson bag them up.

Zhao Rongjun, who had watched the entire process, had to lean in and whisper to Li Luo in admiration, "I really can't learn this from you. Don't they all look pretty much the same? How did you manage to come up with so much to say?"

"You still have a lot to learn." Li Luo rolled his eyes, feeling his throat was about to go up in smoke.

However, the girls weren't done after buying their clothes. Ying Chanxi pulled Li Luo to the men's clothing store next door and started picking out clothes for him. After a round of friendly fighting, Ying Chanxi bought Li Luo a down jacket, Yan Zhusheng picked out a sweater, and Xu Youyu chose a pair of pants for him, completing a full set.

When they came out of the Yintai Department Store building, Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun both let out a long sigh of relief.

It was as if they had finally seen the light of day again, reborn.

"Let's call it a day then. See you tomorrow." Li Luo glanced at the time; it was almost five in the afternoon. "Be safe on your way home."

At the intersection, they parted ways with the others. With eight or nine large bags in his hands, Li Luo walked home with Ying Chanxi.

Jincheng Community was not far from Yintai Department Store, only a few minutes' walk away.

When the two of them arrived home, loaded with bags big and small, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were already busy in the kitchen making dinner.

Placing the things in his hands on the floor, Li Luo went to the kitchen doorway and asked, "Need any help?"

"Oh, you're back?" Lin Xiuhong glanced at her son and jutted her chin toward the sink. "Get a cloth and go wipe the table outside."

"Alright." Li Luo nodded, picked up a cloth, and washed it.

"Oh, right, when are your school's final exams?" Lin Xiuhong asked Li Luo while stir-frying vegetables.

"In about a week," Li Luo replied. "The finals are from the 21st to the 23rd of this month. Then there's one more week of classes, and we start winter break at the end of the month."

"I see." Lin Xiuhong nodded, thought for a moment, and said, "Then after your exams are over, I'll take you to buy some new clothes for the New Year."

"Uh..." Hearing this, Li Luo suddenly felt a bit embarrassed. "As for new clothes... I've already bought them."

"You did? What did you buy?" Lin Xiuhong paused, scooping the freshly cooked dish onto a plate with a look of confusion. "You bought clothes yourself?"

"Auntie Lin, I bought them for him." Ying Chanxi poked her head into the kitchen and said with a grin, "A few friends and I went shopping at the mall this afternoon and bought some clothes, so I bought him a piece on the way."

"You child, really." Lin Xiuhong said with a helpless laugh. "That's such an expense, buying him clothes too."

"It's nothing." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "What's the expense? Li Luo always takes good care of me over at Bihai Lanting. I just bought him a piece of clothing."

"Look at her." Lin Xiuhong walked out of the kitchen with the plate and gestured at Li Luo. "Learn a thing or two. She even knew to buy you new clothes. What about you?"

After speaking, Lin Xiuhong walked to the living room, placed the plate on the dining table, and then her eyes fell on the large pile of bags by the door. She froze for a moment. "...What is all this?"

"Ahem." Li Luo coughed lightly beside her. "I also bought some clothes, for you and Dad to wear, and also for grandpa, grandma, and my maternal grandparents."

The comeback came so fast that Lin Xiuhong didn't quite react.

She blinked, feeling a little embarrassed, and could only mutter quietly in Li Luo's ear, "You brat, spending money recklessly just because you have some, huh? So many clothes, how much did that cost? You don't know how to save."

Li Luo: "..."

Alright, alright, you're right no matter what you say, aren't you?

Li Luo was quite familiar with his mom's temper, so he didn't bother arguing with her. He just found it amusing and chuckled.

Li Guohong also poked his head out to look at the pile of clothes by the door and asked with a raised eyebrow, "I got some too?"

"Everyone has some."

"Guess you have some conscience after all, you brat," Li Guohong chuckled. "Though it'd be better if they could be exchanged for cigarettes."

"What are you thinking?" Lin Xiuhong shot him a glare. "It's either cigarettes or alcohol all day. Don't you know how to quit?"

"I'm already smoking very little, just half a pack a day," Li Guohong retorted. "Other people smoke two or three packs a day."

"Now you're getting cocky, aren't you?"

The couple bickered for a bit, both topics they had argued about countless times.

Soon, dinner was served on the table.

After the family enjoyed the delicious meal, Ying Chanxi helped with the dishes and then returned to her apartment across the hall to review her lessons.

Li Luo, on the other hand, picked up two bags from the doorway and handed them to Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong. "These two are for you. See if they fit. If not, we can still return or exchange them."

"As for these other four bags, these two are for Grandpa and Grandma, and these two are for my maternal grandparents. I have to go back to school tomorrow afternoon and won't have time to deliver them myself. Could you help me give them out?"

"If they don't fit, just take this receipt to the store to exchange the size."

Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were both quite happy at this moment. They unwrapped the packages and opened the bags with the new clothes.

Although she had verbally chided Li Luo for not knowing how to save money, how could a mother not be happy when her son bought her new clothes? The corners of her mouth were about to reach the heavens.

But just then, Li Guohong noticed something.

"Li Luo, what about the remaining three bags?" Li Guohong asked strangely. "Xixi bought you three pieces of clothing?"

"Um... well..." Li Luo scratched his head. "This one was bought by Xixi, this one was a gift from Yan Zhusheng, and this pair of pants was bought by Xu Youyu."

At these words, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong fell silent for a moment, not knowing what to say.

(End of Chapter)
